personality_one_liner: An ultra-premium, cinematic dark-mode command center where golden accents illuminate deep analytics and every entity is a touch away.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for cinematic feel; tight grouping within KPI clusters.

do's: Use heavy tinted glass (bg-black/70 + strong blur) for Detail Sheets and Modal Headers.
Apply glass to the Merchant Social Overlay pills to keep the UGC content visible.
Use subtle glass for the bottom tab bar to let scrolling content peek through.
dont's: Do not use glass for dense KPI text containers or basic list items.
Avoid stacking more than two glass layers.

screens.name: Live Preview Tab Bar
screens.purpose: Global RTL navigation for the merchant view.
screens.layout: RTL strict alignment. Tabs from Right to Left: المتجر (Store - Default) -> الصيانة (Maintenance) -> المسابقات (Competitions) -> السوشيال ميديا (Social Media) -> العام (General). Icons are filled when active (Gold), outlined when inactive (muted gray). Glassmorphic background.

screens.name: General Tab Overview (العام)
screens.purpose: The main hub listing all key entities (Branches, Drivers, Marketers, Employees) as tappable summary cards.

states.loading: Shimmer skeletons for cards, maintaining the grid/list structure.
states.empty: Gold-tinted minimalistic illustration of a magnifying glass over a document, text: 'لا توجد بيانات متاحة بعد' (No data available yet).
states.error: Centered error text with a golden 'إعادة المحاولة' (Retry) button.

screens.layout: Vertical scrolling view. Top: Horizontal scrollable segmented chips to filter (الكل, الفروع, السائقين, المسوقين, الموظفين). Below: Stacked Cards for each entity. Each card has an Avatar/Icon on the right (RTL), Title, 1-2 key metrics, and an arrow indicating drill-down capability. E.g., Driver card shows online status (green pulse ring).

screens.name: Entity Detail Sheets (Drill-downs)
screens.purpose: 90% Gorhom Bottom Sheets providing deep, interconnected analytics for a tapped entity.

states.empty: N/A - Data should be present if sheet opens.
states.error: Toast message on failure to load deep stats.

screens.layout: Glassmorphic header with close button. Header Section: Large Entity Avatar, Name, Status Pill. Middle Section: KPI grid (2-col or 3-col horizontal scroll). Dynamic Charts (Sparklines for Revenue, Ring charts for Internal vs App orders). Interconnectivity: Horizontal lists of connected entities (e.g., 'Staff on Shift' avatars inside Branch sheet) that push a new sheet when tapped.

screens.name: Social Media Tab (السوشيال ميديا)
screens.purpose: 1:1 visual clone of customer feed with added merchant analytics overlay.

states.empty: Illustration of a camera/feed, text: 'لم تقم بنشر أي محتوى بعد' (No posts published yet).

screens.layout: Vertical infinite scroll of rich media cards. EXACT layout of customer social feed. Added UI: A top-left glassmorphic pill on each post showing quick stats (👁️ 1.2K). Added 'إحصائيات' (Insights) golden button on the action bar. Tapping Insights opens a Bottom Sheet with detailed engagement (List of users who liked/shared, link tracking, direct reply input).

screens.name: Supervisor System Flow
screens.purpose: Allows supervisors to add notes and ratings to Employee profiles.

states.loading: Button shows loading indicator during submission.
states.empty: No notes: 'لا توجد ملاحظات المشرف' on the employee sheet.

screens.layout: Triggered via Golden FAB 'إضافة تقييم/ملاحظة' on Employee Sheet. Opens a secondary stacked Bottom Sheet. Contains a 5-star rating (or sliders for specific metrics), a large text area (`surfaceTertiary` background), and a sticky full-width submit button at the bottom.

empty_state_general.alt: Abstract minimalistic dark golden texture for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT RTL ENFORCEMENT: All layouts must use flex-direction: row-reverse or be properly internationalized for Arabic. The Tab bar order MUST be (from right to left in UI): المتجر (Store) -> الصيانة (Maintenance) -> المسابقات (Competitions) -> السوشيال ميديا (Social Media) -> العام (General).
THEME: Implement 'Luxe Dark' strictly. Use deep obsidian (#080808) for backgrounds and Zenrex Gold (#D4AF37) for primary accents and active states. Do NOT use default blue or purple anywhere.

NAVIGATION GRAPH: The 'General' tab must act as a master list. Tapping a card must invoke a Gorhom Bottom Sheet for the drill-down (Driver, Branch, Marketer, Employee). These sheets must support stacked navigation (e.g., tapping an Employee from within a Branch sheet opens a new Employee sheet over it).

SOCIAL TAB: Re-use the existing customer social feed UI components but wrap them or inject a 'MerchantOverlay' component. This overlay is a glassmorphic pill showing stats, and triggers an 'Insights' bottom sheet for deep analytics.
COMPETITIVE EDGE 1 - AI Pulse: Add a subtle animated pulsing ring (using Reanimated) around active Drivers or highly active Branches to signify live data flow.
COMPETITIVE EDGE 2 - Haptic Charts: When implementing Sparklines or Area charts (using Victory Native or similar), attach gesture handlers that fire light haptics as the user scrubs over data points.
SUPERVISOR FLOW: Ensure the 'Add Note' capability uses a nested bottom sheet and clearly associates the created note with the specific employee. Use `surfaceTertiary` for input backgrounds.
